name: DREAMS
description: Active attention and engagement are important in improving users' learning experiences. Engagement refers to the level of involvement and interest individuals show towards a particular task. Attention, on the other hand, refers to a state where someone is entirely focused on a particular task with conscious awareness. Engagement and attention are different but closely linked concepts and can influence each other bidirectionally. To explore the relationship between user engagement and attention, we introduce the Diverse Reactions of Engagement and Attention Mind States (DREAMS) dataset.
